title: AltGDA Achieves Global $O(1/T)$ Ergodic Convergence in Matrix Games
summary: Alternating gradient descent-ascent (AltGDA) is a simple and practically effective method for solving finite two-player zero-sum matrix games. However, the theory of AltGDA remains limited: existing results either apply only to unconstrained settings or require restrictive assumptions on the equilibrium in constrained settings. We show that AltGDA converges globally at an $O(1/T)$ ergodic rate in every finite two-player zero-sum matrix game.
